target_customer: Cultivated meat manufacturers that would license a scaffold and production technology
problem: Cultivated meat is hard to scale and costly. Micro Meat proposed a scaffold system to raise cell yield for producers.
business_model: Technology licensing and services to cultivated meat producers

founders.name: Anne-Sophie Mertgen
founders.background_notes: Later runs Pythag Tech per YC page; listed as a former founder.

founders.name: Vincent Pribble
founders.background_notes: Some sources list Mertgen as sole founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Scaling cell culture for meat is an unsolved bioprocessing problem needing lab capacity and biology expertise, with only a small team.

defensibility.rationale: A working scaffold could be patentable, but no evidence of patents or validated results; claims were the company's own.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No evidence of incumbents acting on this wedge; the company appears to have gone quiet after 2022.

market_need_then: Cultivated meat was drawing investor and press interest around 2021, with first sales in Singapore reported in December 2020 per a search summary. Producers needed cheaper scale-up.

branding.domain_note: micromeat.com existed per YC listing but the site now returns 404.
branding.community_and_virality: Press described it as Mexico's first cultivated meat startup (vegconomist, Green Queen).

brand_strength.rationale: Some trade press in 2021 and 2022, no distinctive identity found, site dead.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Micro Meat as inactive and the company site is dead. Press from 2022 covered its launch as a scaffold service, an accelerator place and a space partnership, and aggregators show a small seed in 2022. No shutdown announcement or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.
notes: Status is Inactive but exit type is unknown because no source describes a shutdown. Funding figures conflict across aggregators ($130K to $525K; a $250K seed in June 2022; a $125K pre-seed in Jan 2021 only on Bouncewatch) and no primary source or second outlet confirmed any round, so none is recorded. Website returned 404. Competitor search found Mexican peers (Forma Foods) but nothing dated near mid-2021 with traction data, so the list is empty. A page titled Micro Meat USA claims economic failure and is unreliable.
